'''Anthony M. Trozzolo''' (January 11, 1930 – July 1, 2026) was an American chemist.

== Early life and career ==
Trozzolo was born in [[Chicago]], Illinois, on January 11, 1930, the son of Pasquale and Francesca Trozzolo. He attended [[Crane High School (Chicago)|Crane Tech High School]], graduating at the age of sixteen. After graduating, he attended the [[Illinois Institute of Technology]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|BS degree]] in [[chemistry]] in 1950. He also attended the [[University of Chicago]], earning his [[Master of Science|MS degree]] in 1957 and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1960. He worked as a research [[chemist]] at [[Bell Labs]] in [[Murray Hill, New Jersey]] until 1975.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.southbendtribune.com/obituaries/psbn1517630|title=Dr. Anthony M. Trozzolo|work=[[South Bend Tribune]]|date=July 8, 2026|access-date=July 11, 2026}}</ref> During his time at Bell Labs, in 1963, he was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=trozzolo&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=July 11, 2026}}</ref>

He served as a professor in the department of chemistry at the [[University of Notre Dame]] from 1975 to 1998. During his years as a professor, in 1975, he was named the Charles L. Huisking Professor of Chemistry.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://chemistry.nd.edu/news/in-memoriam-anthony-m-trozzolo-charles-l-huisking-professor-emeritus/|title=In Memoriam: Anthony M. Trozzolo, Charles L. Huisking Professor Emeritus|work=[[University of Notre Dame]]|first=Ella|last=Tarner|date=July 10, 2026|access-date=July 11, 2026}}</ref> In 2011, he was named a fellow of the [[American Chemical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://chemistry.nd.edu/people/anthony-trozzolo/|title=Anthony Trozzolo|work=[[University of Notre Dame]]|access-date=July 11, 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240819071341/https://chemistry.nd.edu/people/anthony-trozzolo/|archive-date=August 19, 2024|url-status=live|via=[[Wayback Machine]]}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
In 1955, Trozzolo married Doris Stoffregen in [[Saint Peter, Minnesota]]. Their marriage lasted until her death in 2011.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/ladailynews/name/doris-trozzolo-obituary?id=22502995|title=Doris Trozzolo Obituary (1932–2011)|work=[[Los Angeles Daily News]]|date=May 29, 2011|access-date=July 11, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>

Trozzolo died at the Saint Joseph Regional Medical Center in [[Mishawaka, Indiana]], on July 1, 2026, at the age of 96.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.echovita.com/us/obituaries/in/crane/anthony-trozzolo-21776683|title=Anthony M. Trozzolo|work=Echovita|access-date=July 11, 2026}}</ref>
